business_goal: Allow new users to create an account so they can access personalized shopping features.
scope: Enable new users to register with full name, email, and password
Validate that email is not already registered
Generate and return a JWT token upon successful registration
Reuse existing User/UserCredentials data model for registration

functional_requirements.description: User can register using full name, email, and password
System must validate that the email is not already registered
System must hash the password before storing it
Upon successful registration, the system must create a new user record and return a JWT authentication token
System must reuse the existing User/UserCredentials data model used by the Login feature, extending it with a fullName field rather than creating a separate model

non_functional_requirements.description: Signup response should be fast, similar to login

user_stories.goal: I want to create an account so I can access personalized shopping features
user_stories.benefit: I can enjoy a tailored shopping experience with saved preferences and order history

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a new, unregistered email, valid password, and full name, the user is registered and redirected to the dashboard with a valid JWT
Given an email that is already registered, the system displays a clear error message and does not create a duplicate account
Given the signup page, the user must be able to navigate to the existing login page for users who already have an account

output_requirements: Error messages for duplicate emails or invalid inputs
ui_expectations: Signup form with fields for full name, email, password, and confirm password
Link to the existing login page for users who already have an account
api_expectations: Return JWT token after successful registration

validation_rules.description: Password must be at least 8 characters long
Email must be in a valid format
Confirm password must match the entered password

constraints: Reuse the existing UserCredentials model and authentication infrastructure already built for the Login feature instead of duplicating it
assumptions: The Login feature and its UserCredentials model already exist in this codebase
The JWT token generation and handling logic is already implemented and reusable
The frontend will handle form validation before submission
risks: Password hashing implementation may introduce performance bottlenecks
Reusing existing models may cause compatibility issues if not properly extended
